exposure: transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block with liposomal bupivacaine
Women with a prior history of substance use disorders
Transversus abdominis plane block with liposomal bupivacaine
cohort: Women who gave birth by cesarean section at a rural hospital in southeast Ohio
finding: Liposomal bupivacaine, whether administered via wound infiltration or transversus abdominis plane block, resulted in significantly lower opioid consumption and improved pain management after cesarean section compared to standard spinal anesthesia.
